name: Alphabet Inc.
description:
## Business Overview
Alphabet Inc. is a holding company whose largest subsidiary is **Google**, generating most revenue from **advertising** sold across **Google Search** and **YouTube**, plus **subscription** and **cloud** revenue (e.g., **Google Cloud**).

## Market Position
Google is a leading global consumer internet and advertising platform with strong distribution via **Android** and **Chrome**, and a large creator/video ecosystem in **YouTube**, supporting broad reach and data-driven ad targeting.

## Key Segments
Alphabet reports results primarily through **Google Services** (Search, YouTube, Android, Chrome, hardware, and consumer subscriptions), **Google Cloud** (cloud infrastructure and productivity tools), and **Other Bets** (early-stage businesses such as **Waymo**).
